source_en: Dionise Chkonia, professor of philosophy. Back from the archive again.
The librarian lets me take whatever books are worth saving.
Plato, Rustaveli, two banned Russians. Confiscate them if it makes you feel useful.
The dust gets into the pages. Soon there'll be no one left to read them.
I still lecture on schedule. Half the hall is empty now.
Some left. Some cough at home, and the rest pretend nothing is wrong.
Any of them from the east?
Three. They stopped coming after the blast, and I stopped asking.
Routine reassures, Officer. Even yours. Especially yours.
